roster_focus.question: The brief states there was a recent Aurora roster change. What is actually verifiable today?
roster_focus.finding: The most recent Aurora lineup change that any reviewed source records is the July 2026 international rebuild. No October 2026 Aurora roster move (bench, stand-in, departure or signing) was found in any reviewed source, and Aurora fielded the same five in both TWC matches.

timeline.event: Aurora sign Jimpphat (from MOUZ) and ashhh as coach (from GamerLegion)
Aurora acquire kyxsan from Falcons to complete the roster; kyxsan takes over as IGL
New lineup's first official appearance: BLAST Bounty 2026 Season 2 online stage

verified_consequences.fact: kyxsan spent over two months inactive before joining (removed from the Falcons starting roster before the IEM Cologne Major when karrigan arrived)

Aurora's coach ash (3 months on the team, 63 maps coached, 62% win rate per HLTV) described nerves, communication changes and cultural integration as the early problems, and said practice form looked better than official form

Aurora reached the IEM Cologne Major semi-final before the rebuild; after it they took 2nd at StarLadder StarSeries Fall 2026 (losing the final 1-3 to Vitality) and 3rd at ESL Pro League Season 24, and entered TWC 2026 as HLTV #6 / VRS #9 (5 October snapshot)
Aurora's starting five at TWC 2026 is unchanged from the July rebuild: woxic, XANTARES, Wicadia, Jimpphat, kyxsan
The opposing side of the decider, 9z, is the same five-man roster recorded in the official VRS on 2026-10-05 (dgt, HUASOPEEK, luchov, max, meyern)

roster_focus.rest_and_onboarding_evidence: No source reviewed in this session states how many days off either roster had, or publishes any rest measurement, so no rest penalty or bonus is applied. The only verifiable onboarding facts are the dated July signings above and the 0.53 rating kyxsan posted in the day-1 loss at this event.

HotSpawn renders lobby kickoff times in US Eastern (EDT, UTC-4), not UTC: the lobby shows 'Oct 16, 10:00' for a match every other source dates 14:00 UTC and '13:00' for one dated 17:00 UTC. Times on this site are published in UTC with the ET display shown alongside.
HLTV returns HTTP 403 to the automated collector, so HLTV facts on this site are dated manual reads with URLs and read times, not machine-collected rows. This does not prove HLTV lacks odds or cover.

The HotSpawn card advertises listed points plus tier and stage multipliers (e.g. '7 pts', 'Tier S x3', 'Multiplier x1.25') but does not state how they combine into the final score. Leaderboard differentials are therefore published in listed points only, never in score-adjusted points.

The Group B decider (BetBoom vs Legacy) has no HLTV match id captured in this session and did not exist in the canonical 23:40Z fixture set; its line comes from a retained Melbet quote joined by pair, event and start time.

Kalshi markets exist for the day-3 deciders but one of them (BetBoom/Legacy) has bid/ask spreads of 32 and 35 cents and is unusable as a probability; it is published as a wide-spread cross-check only.
EGamersWorld lists 1.80/1.80 for ex-RUSTEC vs Saint Sinners, which is not credible as a two-sided market and is rejected rather than averaged in.

Crowd ownership is a rendered snapshot of the public lobby at the capture time. Vote counts move; the pages show the capture time next to every ownership number and never treat it as live or as a probability.

The canonical board's own freshness window had elapsed at the time this hub was first built (quotes retrieved 2026-10-15T23:40:36Z, four-hour window). Rows carry the quote age and are re-derived by the four-hourly workflow; expired quotes are labelled, never silently refreshed.

limitations: HotSpawn is used for fixture discovery, listed points/tier, lock times and crowd ownership only. It is never a probability input.
No source reviewed here publishes how many days of rest a team had, so no rest adjustment is applied anywhere.
The model column is this project's own calibrated calculation from official Valve ratings. It is not a bookmaker line and carries no claimed out-of-sample accuracy.
Playoff fixtures beyond the two day-3 deciders were not listed on the HotSpawn lobby at capture time, so they are not priced here.
Ratings come from the 2026-10-05 global standings because that is the newest official global file published at capture time; HLTV's live VRS chip shows #5 for Aurora, which the model does not use.

context_facts_policy: A context fact may support the climb candidate only when it is dated, source-linked and about that side or about the head-to-head. The gate requires at least one such fact for the candidate side.

flags.title: Newer exchange reads can omit the kickoff the contract rules state
flags.detail: The 2026-10-16 04:40Z Kalshi read returned the same event ids as the 2026-10-15 23:40Z read without the contract-rule kickoff field, which would have made three already-resolvable rows blank again. The hub therefore publishes the newest prices and carries the kickoff forward from the older read of the same contract id, naming that read and time in the row source.
